messages:
mike_support: FYI customer (Acme Corp) seeing intermittent 401s and streaming cutoff after ~10-20s when calling our streaming endpoint via their corporate proxy. They gave one request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Asking for help to get a minimal curl repro and the right debug bundle to escalate.

sophia_eng_oncall: Thanks — we'll need a minimal, runnable curl (no redaction of headers besides the API key itself), response headers with x-request-id, and a curl trace. Ask them to include curl -v -i -N and --trace-ascii. Also confirm their proxy type (CONNECT vs. HTTP) and curl version.

mike_support: Copying checklist I'm about to send them. Keeping it short so they actually run it.

mike_support: Checklist to send customer: 1) Full curl command you used (replace key with $TOKEN but keep all headers) 2) Run with -v -i -N and attach stdout/stderr 3) Add --trace-ascii /tmp/curl.trace (or paste output) 4) Response headers (we need x-request-id / x-rw-trace fields) 5) Curl version and OS, proxy type & host 6) Try forcing --http1.1 and --no-buffer (-N) to rule out http2/proxy buffering 7) If streaming cuts, capture time to cutoff and whether replays reconnect automatically

emma_devex: Also ask them to try this minimal command locally and paste the full output. It forces headers we care about and keeps buffering off:

```
# replace $TOKEN and $URL
curl -v -i -N \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Debug: 1" \
  --http1.1 \
  --max-time 120 \
  "$URL/v1/chat/stream?model=gpt-neo-1"
```

emma_devex: If they can't share their proxy, ask them to run the same command with no proxy (if possible) or point to a public tunnel (ngrok) so we can isolate proxy vs service.

sophia_eng_oncall: On our side, if they provide req id + trace header we can look up the server trace. Please tell them to capture response headers including any x-request-id, x-rw-trace, and Date. If they see 401, have them paste the full WWW-Authenticate header (some proxies rewrite auth headers).

sophia_eng_oncall: Additional tips to include for them: - try adding `--header "Connection: keep-alive"` - try `--no-keepalive` if proxy injects keepalive behavior - try both HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 (-0) to see difference.

mike_support: I'll ask for the curl output and the small trace file. If they reproduce, request a minimal gzip of the trace and the raw output. If it's sensitive, they can scrub tokens but keep x-request-id values.

deploy-bot: NOTE: if you provide x-rw-trace we can map to internal request logs; include region if known (e.g., us-west-2).

mike_support: Perfect. I'll send the checklist now and ask them to run the exact command in the snippet above. Will update this thread when they respond with the trace/req id. :thumbsup:

sophia_eng_oncall: If they come back with partial output that shows chunked EOF from the proxy, we'll ask for a pcap as next step but only after curl --trace-ascii confirms. Keep the ask incremental to avoid blocking them.

mike_support: Thanks all — sending now.
